text:
anna-partnerships: Heads-up — Partner teams asked for a clearer, partner-type specific deprecation cadence for upcoming SDK changes (auth header + client handshake). Can we propose something they can publish to marketplace partners?

leo-sdks: +1. They want concrete dates and an opt-in feature flag for early adopters, right?

anna-partnerships: Exactly. Prefer 3-stage runway: announce -> opt-in canary -> enforced removal. Different windows for ISVs, HW partners, and SIs.

matt-eng: Sounds good. We should also map to deployment modes (hosted vs dedicated vs private). Private customers need a separate opt-out flow and longer runway.

gabe-hw: For hardware partners we need certification time — recommend 6 months opt-in period then 3 months notice before enforced switch. Hardware vendors often need build/test cycles.

leo-sdks: Proposed defaults (feel free to tweak): ISV: announce 60d -> canary 30d -> enforce 30d. HW: announce 180d -> canary 90d -> enforce 90d. SIs: announce 120d -> canary 60d -> enforce 60d.

sara-ops: We need automation for feature flag toggles and per-partner rollouts. Can we attach partner IDs to the flag so we don't have to hand-edit infra?

matt-eng: Yes — we can add a per-partner toggle in the routing layer. Schema: `partner_flags:{"partner_id": {"compat_v2": true}}`. Will need a short-lived passthrough for non-upgraded clients.

leo-sdks: Also adding migration snippet for partners (to include in partner docs):

```
# old
Authorization: Bearer <token>

# new (compat-v2)
X-Redwood-Client: <client-id>
X-Redwood-Sig: <sig>
```

Use library helpers `rw.auth.migrate_token()` to produce the new headers.

john-sales: From GTM side we want a single public timeline for marketplace listings + partner portal calendar. Partners get an email and a dedicated slack invite for early canary.

anna-partnerships: Agree. Can we align dates this week? I'll draft the partner-facing comms. Need legal + security sign-off copy.

gabe-hw: Also flag for certification: `cert-window: 90d` for hardware partners so they can schedule QA.

leo-sdks: Tech ask: add a compatibility header that lets us serve old and new formats in parallel, e.g., `Rw-Compat: v1|v2`. Routing layer will check `Rw-Compat` then partner_flags fallback.

matt-eng: I'll prototype the header check and flag lookup. Will post a PR with tests by EOD Friday.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Created canary toggle task #4527 for `compat_v2` and scheduled feature-flag namespace `partners/compat`.

sara-ops: When PR is ready we should run a small tabletop with a hardware partner and one SI. Ops will run the rollout playbook.

anna-partnerships: Perfect. Action items: Leo draft SDK migration guide, Matt prototype header/flags, Gabe confirm cert windows with HW PMs, Sara schedule tabletop, I'll draft comms + partner invite. Planning to publish tentative timeline to the partner portal next Tue. :calendar:

leo-sdks: I'll put the migration guide in `partners/sdk-migration.md` and ping here when done.

john-sales: I'll prep the marketplace banner copy and coordinate the joint announcement window — prefer to avoid major cloud marketplace holidays.

anna-partnerships: Thanks everyone. If we diverge from the defaults above call it out in this thread so I can keep the partner-facing timeline accurate. :thumbsup:
